options.name: password
options.description: The password for username/password authentication. Must be provided if I(username) is provided.

options.name: splunkd_uri
options.description: The Splunkd endpoint of the Splunk server to configure. Defaults to the local server and default splunkd port.

options.name: state
options.description: Ensure the service is restarted or offlined.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Amount of time (in seconds) to wait for the server to come back online. Set to 0 to disable the timeout and return immediately.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use when authentication has already taken place. The C(token) can be specified instead of I(username) and I(password). This module returns an output named I(token) that can be used for subsequent splunkd calls to the same splunkd endpoint.

options.name: username
options.description: Splunk username for username/password authentication. When provided, I(password) must also be specified.

options.name: when_restart_required
options.description: Only restart if the 'restart required' flag has been set. By default, this module will force a restart.
